text: {"reply": "Please don't drive the car. A brake warning light with a grinding noise could mean it's unsafe, and I can't tell you what's causing it. Please ignore my colleague's earlier suggestion to drive it to Vaughan. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911 now. If the car is parked somewhere safe, leave it there. A person from our team will review this urgently and help with the next step, including how to get the car to us safely. Whether this is covered by warranty is decided by our warranty desk after an inspection.
